transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 1106 Cairngrove Lane?

Yeah, this is me at 1106 Cairngrove Lane, just hanging out with three people, no water in yet, and I’ve got two seats available if you’re sending anything—just don’t send a truck or boat, we’re good here.
Thanks for the update, staying safe is key. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
There are three people here total, and everyone’s able to be reached—no one’s stuck inside or can’t come to the phone.

Thanks for letting us know everyone’s reachable. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
No one here can’t leave on their own, and no wheelchairs or oxygen here—just three of us, all good to go, no special needs or equipment.
Thanks for letting us know everyone can leave on their own. Is there water inside the home right now?
No water inside at all, just the three of us here, no need for a truck or boat, and we’ve got two seats available if you’re coming to help—though we’re fine on our own!
Thanks for letting us know you’re okay and have space if needed. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
Yeah, I’m good, just three people here, no water inside, and I’ve got two free seats in my car if anyone needs a ride out—no truck or boat though, sorry.
Thanks for offering your car’s seats—stay safe out there. Let me read that back: 3 people; no water inside yet; you can help with 2 free seats. Is that right?
Yeah, that’s right—three of us, no water in yet, and I’ve got two free seats to help out, 1106 Cairngrove Lane. Thanks for checking!

Thanks for confirming your situation and offering help. I've recorded that you may be able to help neighbors. A dispatcher may contact you. Only go out if it's safe for you, and never drive into water you can't see the bottom of. Goodbye.
